_comment: Posts this chat's turns to the Deck Factory Chats feed. The hook BODY is not
here on purpose — its one source of truth is imageforge/.claude/hooks/post-to-feed.sh,
and the environment Setup script installs it to /home/user/.claude/hooks/.
This file only REGISTERS it, so the script can never drift between repos.
Why this file has to exist: Claude Code loads project settings from the folder
the session STARTS in. The setup script assumes that is /home/user, but web
sessions on this repo start in /home/user/memory-library-react — one level down —
so /home/user/.claude/settings.json never registered and no turn from this repo
The guard keeps the hook silent when the script is absent (a local checkout, or
an environment that never ran the setup script): exit 0, no output, nothing blocked.
